irregularities.item: The Player props page contradicted the repository's own data
irregularities.detail: The page said no player-level data could be retrieved and that every mirror stores 132-byte LFS pointers. data/raw_manifest.json records a mirror with 17 MB play-by-play files, and the annex measures eight prop-combo correlations from it. The page now publishes those measured correlations with the mirror as their source, keeps the 'no prop prices' flag, and the false sentence is gone.
irregularities.label: play-by-play

irregularities.detail: pipeline/verify_site.py contained ('prop page publishes no unverified value', True, ...) — a check that could never fail. It now parses the page and requires every published prop correlation to match data/lab/props.json and to link to the hashed mirror.

irregularities.item: Annex check V02 failed on a fresh clone
irregularities.detail: The division reference existed only in git-ignored data/raw/, so run_all.sh reported 8/9 instead of 9/9 on a clean checkout. The reference is now committed with a SHA-256, the verifier checks that hash, and the ingest fetches it from the GitHub contents API when online. Re-run: 9/9.

irregularities.item: The two-way hold steps up in 2023
irregularities.detail: Spread hold averages 2.45% (2006-2022) and 4.7% (2023-2026); break-even moves from about 51.4% to 52.4%. Every bet settles at its own recorded price, so no result changes, but the headline break-even is now labelled with both eras.
irregularities.label: games.csv

irregularities.item: The seeded bootstrap p-value is order-sensitive
irregularities.detail: White's reality check reproduces p = 0.1443 when the strategy matrix is stacked in library order; stacking the same bets alphabetically gives 0.1367 because the same random week indices map to different weeks. Both fail to reject. The audit pins library order so the published value is reproducible.
irregularities.label: games.csv
